articles.title: State Police trooper suspended after allegedly stealing Bobcat excavator
articles.description:
Trooper Joseph Franklin faces two felony charges. He pleaded not guilty at an arraignment last month.

The post State Police trooper suspended after allegedly stealing Bobcat excavator appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: State Police trooper Joseph Franklin suspended after alleged theft of Bobcat excavator.
Franklin faces two felony charges and pleaded not guilty at last month's arraignment.
Incident raises concerns about accountability within Massachusetts State Police for Boston residents.

articles.title: Former FIFA VP Prince Ali cites ‘blackmail’ by Infantino-led soccer body over unpaid prize money
articles.description:
"The whole situation amounts to blackmail and we refuse to give in to that,” the Jordanian royal wrote Tuesday.
